||Although I do not wish to see my Knight, Sir Oaken, The Golden Heart take the steps into the unknown, know that you are not alone. You have set on your choice, and although it pains me with all strain, your freedom is yours to choose. I hope to see your return, you carry the best of us even though you shut yourself off. content: Web takes the mushroom pendant. "If i truly cannot change your mind, then I will ask this of you: You, and not anyone else, will move me out of the way. You will look me in the eyes when you do so. And you will promise to come back." Web hands Amara a long silver thread. "Your mind is a wonderful thing, and you deserve so much better than this. I have never regretted a moment of the time I have spent with you." Web weaves the small mushroom pendant through the silvery thread and ties it around her neck. "You are so many things to so many people. I cannot possibly understand your decision, but if your heart is set I cannot stop you. I have been honored to call you my friend. May your death have meaning, and may your mind and body rest as they deserve. You will not be forgotten. Not now, and not ever." Web kisses her on the forehead as if in benediction and  takes a step back, tears running down their face. "I love you, as a friend and as an ally. Do what you must."
